text: 📗 English Language – 100 प्रश्नों की क्विज़ सुपर TET की तैयारी के लिए उत्तर टिक करें, सही उत्तर व व्याख्या उसके बाद दिखेगी ✅ चैनल 👉 @examhub26 ग्रुप 👉 @examhub2026

q: Q1. Choose the correct article: He is ___ honest man.
explain: 'honest' में h silent है, उच्चारण स्वर (ऑ) से शुरू – इसलिए 'an'।

q: Q2. Choose the correct article: She is ___ European and works at ___ university.
explain: European (यू) और university (यू) की ध्वनि 'य' (व्यंजन) से शुरू होती है – इसलिए 'a'।

q: Q3. Choose the correct option: ___ Ganga is ___ holy river.
explain: नदियों के नाम से पहले 'the'; सामान्य एकवचन संज्ञा 'holy river' से पहले 'a'।

q: Q4. Choose the correct sentence.
explain: खेलों के नाम से पहले article नहीं लगता।

q: Q5. Choose the correct option: ___ rich should help ___ poor.
explain: Adjective को वर्ग (class) के रूप में प्रयोग करने पर 'the' – the rich, the poor।

q: Q6. Choose the correct form: He ___ in Lucknow since 2015.
explain: 'since' + लगातार चल रहा कार्य – Present Perfect Continuous।

q: Q7. Choose the correct form: By the time we reached the station, the train ___.
explain: भूतकाल में दो कार्य – पहले हुए कार्य के लिए Past Perfect (had + V3)।

q: Q8. Choose the correct form: The sun ___ in the east.
explain: सार्वभौमिक सत्य – Simple Present।

q: Q9. Choose the correct form: I ___ him yesterday.
explain: 'yesterday' (निश्चित भूतकाल) के साथ Present Perfect नहीं, Simple Past।

q: Q10. Choose the correct form: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
explain: First conditional – If + present, will + V1।

q: Q11. Choose the correct form: If I ___ a bird, I would fly in the sky.
explain: काल्पनिक स्थिति (Second conditional) में सभी कर्ताओं के साथ 'were'।

q: Q12. Choose the correct form: If you had worked hard, you ___.
explain: Third conditional – If + had V3, would have + V3।

q: Q13. Choose the correct form: She ___ for two hours when I arrived.
explain: भूतकाल में किसी समय तक लगातार चल रहा कार्य – Past Perfect Continuous।

q: Q14. Choose the correct form: I will call you when he ___.
explain: Time clause (when, before, after) में future के लिए Simple Present।

q: Q15. Choose the correct verb: Each of the boys ___ a book.
explain: Each / Every / Either / Neither के साथ एकवचन क्रिया।

q: Q16. Choose the correct verb: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ present.
explain: Neither...nor में क्रिया पास वाले कर्ता (students – बहुवचन) के अनुसार।

q: Q17. Choose the correct verb: The number of students ___ increasing.
explain: 'The number of' – एकवचन; 'A number of' – बहुवचन।

q: Q18. Choose the correct verb: A number of students ___ absent today.
explain: 'A number of' का अर्थ 'कई' – बहुवचन क्रिया।

q: Q19. Choose the correct verb: Bread and butter ___ my favourite breakfast.
explain: दो संज्ञाएँ मिलकर एक ही चीज़ का बोध कराएँ तो एकवचन क्रिया।

q: Q20. Choose the correct verb: The Prime Minister, along with his ministers, ___ arrived.
explain: along with / as well as / with से जुड़े शब्द को छोड़कर पहले कर्ता के अनुसार क्रिया।

q: Q21. Choose the correct sentence.
explain: Police, cattle, people – सदैव बहुवचन क्रिया।

q: Q22. Change into passive voice: She writes a letter.
options: A letter has written by her.
A letter is written by her.
A letter was written by her.
A letter is being written by her.
explain: Simple Present passive – is/am/are + V3।

q: Q23. Change into passive voice: They are building a house.
options: A house has been built by them.
A house was being built by them.
A house is being built by them.
A house is built by them.
explain: Present Continuous passive – is/am/are + being + V3।

q: Q24. Change into passive voice: Who taught you English?
options: Who was taught English by you?
By whom was English taught to you?
By whom English was taught to you?
By whom were you teach English?
explain: Who → By whom + was + object + V3?

q: Q25. Change into passive voice: Open the door.
explain: आज्ञावाचक वाक्य का passive – Let + object + be + V3।

q: Q26. Change into passive voice: He has finished the work.
options: The work has been finished by him.
The work had been finished by him.
The work was finished by him.
The work is finished by him.
explain: Present Perfect passive – has/have + been + V3।

q: Q27. Change into passive voice: I can solve this sum.
options: This sum can solved by me.
This sum can be solved by me.
This sum could be solved by me.
This sum is solved by me.
explain: Modal passive – modal + be + V3।

q: Q28. Change into indirect speech: He said, "I am busy."
options: He said that he was busy.
He told that he was busy.
He said that he is busy.
He said that I am busy.
explain: Reporting verb past हो तो present → past; I → he।

q: Q29. Change into indirect speech: She said to me, "Where do you live?"
options: She asked me where I lived.
She asked me where do I live.
She asked me where did I live.
She said me where I lived.
explain: Wh-प्रश्न में said to → asked; वाक्य assertive क्रम में; tense past।

q: Q30. Change into indirect speech: The teacher said, "The earth moves round the sun."
options: The teacher said that the earth moved round the sun.
The teacher said that the earth moves round the sun.
The teacher told the earth moves round the sun.
The teacher said that the earth had moved round the sun.
explain: सार्वभौमिक सत्य का tense indirect speech में नहीं बदलता।

q: Q31. Change into indirect speech: He said to me, "Please help me."
options: He requested me to help him.
He told me please help him.
He said me to help him.
He requested me that help him.
explain: Please वाले आज्ञावाचक वाक्य – requested + to + V1।

q: Q32. Change into indirect speech: He said, "I will go tomorrow."
options: He said that he would go tomorrow.
He said that he would go the next day.
He said that he will go tomorrow.
He said that I would go the next day.
explain: will → would; tomorrow → the next day / the following day।

q: Q33. Change into indirect speech: She said to him, "Are you ready?"
options: She asked him that he was ready.
She asked him if he was ready.
She asked him was he ready.
She said him if he is ready.
explain: Yes/No प्रश्न – if/whether + assertive क्रम।

q: Q34. Fill in the blank: He has been ill ___ Monday.
explain: निश्चित समय-बिंदु के साथ 'since', अवधि के साथ 'for'।

q: Q35. Fill in the blank: He died ___ cholera.
explain: बीमारी से मरना – die of; कारण/चोट से – die from।

q: Q36. Fill in the blank: She is good ___ mathematics.
explain: Good at / Bad at – किसी कौशल/विषय में।

q: Q37. Fill in the blank: I prefer tea ___ coffee.
explain: prefer A to B – 'than' नहीं।

q: Q38. Fill in the blank: He is senior ___ me by two years.
explain: senior, junior, superior, inferior, prior के साथ 'to'।

q: Q39. Fill in the blank: The train arrived ___ Lucknow ___ 5 p.m.
explain: बड़े शहर के लिए arrive in; समय के लिए at।

q: Q40. Fill in the blank: He was accused ___ theft.
explain: accuse someone of something।

q: Q41. Fill in the blank: She is married ___ a doctor.
explain: married to – married with नहीं।

q: Q42. Fill in the blank: The book is divided ___ five chapters.
explain: divide into parts।

q: Q43. Choose the correct modal: You ___ not smoke here. It is prohibited.
explain: निषेध/प्रतिबंध के लिए must not।

q: Q44. Choose the correct modal: ___ I come in, sir?
explain: विनम्र अनुमति माँगने के लिए May।

q: Q45. Choose the correct modal: He is very weak. He ___ walk properly.
explain: क्षमता की कमी – cannot / can't।

q: Q46. Choose the correct modal: You ___ respect your elders.
explain: नैतिक कर्तव्य/सलाह – should / ought to।

q: Q47. Choose the correct option: You ___ to obey your parents.
explain: 'ought' के बाद 'to' आता है – ought to।

q: Q48. Choose the correct question tag: Let's go for a walk, ___?
explain: Let's से शुरू वाक्य – shall we?

q: Q49. Choose the correct question tag: I am right, ___?
explain: I am... के साथ tag – aren't I?

q: Q50. Choose the correct question tag: Nobody came to the party, ___?
explain: Nobody/No one नकारात्मक अर्थ – सकारात्मक tag, सर्वनाम they।

q: Q51. Choose the correct question tag: Open the window, ___?
explain: आज्ञावाचक वाक्य – will you / won't you?

q: Q52. Choose the correct option: He is ___ than his brother.
explain: Double comparative (more taller) गलत है।

q: Q53. Choose the correct option: This is the ___ book I have ever read.
explain: तीन या अधिक में तुलना – superlative।

q: Q54. Choose the correct option: She is ___ of the two sisters.
explain: दो में चुनाव के लिए 'the + comparative' – the taller of the two।

q: Q55. Choose the correct option: He has ___ friends. He feels lonely.
explain: few = लगभग नहीं (नकारात्मक भाव); a few = कुछ।

q: Q56. Choose the correct option: There is ___ milk in the jug. We can make tea.
explain: Uncountable के साथ a little = थोड़ा (पर्याप्त); few/a few countable के लिए।

q: Q57. Choose the correct option: She sings ___.
explain: क्रिया (sings) की विशेषता – adverb 'well'।

q: Q58. Choose the correct option: The milk tastes ___.
explain: taste, smell, look, feel (linking verbs) के बाद adjective।

q: Q59. Identify the part of speech of the underlined word: He runs FAST.
explain: यहाँ 'fast' क्रिया runs की विशेषता बता रहा है – Adverb।

q: Q60. Identify the part of speech of the capital word: He kept a FAST on Monday.
explain: यहाँ 'fast' (व्रत) एक संज्ञा है।

q: Q61. Identify the type of clause: I know WHERE HE LIVES.
explain: यह clause 'know' का object है – Noun clause।

q: Q62. Identify the type of clause: This is the house WHICH JACK BUILT.
explain: Noun 'house' की विशेषता बताता है – Adjective (Relative) clause।

q: Q63. Identify the sentence type: Although he was poor, he was honest.
explain: Main clause + subordinate clause (Although...) – Complex sentence।

q: Q64. Choose the correct relative pronoun: This is the boy ___ father is a teacher.
explain: संबंध/स्वामित्व दिखाने के लिए whose।

q: Q65. Choose the correct option: He is the man ___ I met yesterday.
explain: Relative pronoun object की स्थिति में – whom।

q: Q66. Choose the correct gerund/infinitive: I am looking forward to ___ you.
explain: 'look forward to' में to preposition है – gerund (V-ing)।

q: Q67. Choose the correct option: He avoided ___ the question.
explain: avoid, enjoy, finish, mind के बाद gerund।

q: Q68. Choose the synonym of 'ABUNDANT'.
explain: Abundant = बहुतायत में, प्रचुर।

q: Q69. Choose the synonym of 'CANDID'.
explain: Candid = स्पष्टवादी, खरा।

q: Q70. Choose the synonym of 'BENEVOLENT'.
explain: Benevolent = परोपकारी, दयालु।

q: Q71. Choose the antonym of 'HUMBLE'.
explain: Humble (विनम्र) × Arrogant (घमंडी)।

q: Q72. Choose the antonym of 'EXPAND'.
explain: Expand (फैलना) × Contract (सिकुड़ना)।

q: Q73. One word for: A person who cannot read or write.
explain: Illiterate = निरक्षर; Illegible = जो पढ़ा न जा सके (लिखावट)।

q: Q74. One word for: Life story of a person written by himself.
explain: स्वयं लिखी जीवनी – Autobiography; किसी और द्वारा – Biography।

q: Q75. One word for: A place where birds are kept.
explain: Aviary – पक्षीशाला; Apiary – मधुमक्खीपालन; Aquarium – मछलीघर।

q: Q76. One word for: That which cannot be seen.
explain: Invisible – अदृश्य; Invincible – अजेय; Inaudible – जो सुनाई न दे।

q: Q77. One word for: A person who believes in God.
explain: Theist – आस्तिक; Atheist – नास्तिक।

q: Q78. Meaning of the idiom: 'To beat about the bush'
options: To avoid coming to the point
explain: इधर-उधर की बातें करना, मुख्य बात पर न आना।

q: Q79. Meaning of the idiom: 'Once in a blue moon'
explain: बहुत कम, कभी-कभार।

q: Q80. Meaning of the idiom: 'To burn the midnight oil'
options: To work or study late at night
explain: देर रात तक पढ़ना/काम करना।

q: Q81. Meaning of the idiom: 'To turn a deaf ear'
explain: किसी बात को अनसुना करना।

q: Q82. Meaning of the phrasal verb: 'Look after'
explain: Look after = देखभाल करना; Look for = खोजना।

q: Q83. Meaning of the phrasal verb: 'Put off'
explain: Put off = टालना / स्थगित करना।

q: Q84. Find the error: He (A) / did not (B) / went to school (C) / yesterday. (D)
explain: did/do/does के बाद V1 – 'go to school' होना चाहिए।

q: Q85. Find the error: One of my friend (A) / is (B) / a doctor (C) / in Delhi. (D)
explain: One of + plural noun – 'One of my friends'।

q: Q86. Find the error: She is (A) / more cleverer (B) / than (C) / her sister. (D)
explain: Double comparative गलत – 'cleverer' या 'more clever'।

q: Q87. Find the error: I have seen (A) / him (B) / two days ago (C) / in the market. (D)
explain: 'ago' (निश्चित भूतकाल) के साथ Present Perfect नहीं – 'I saw'।

q: Q88. Find the error: Please (A) / give me (B) / an information (C) / about it. (D)
explain: Information uncountable है – 'an' नहीं लगेगा; 'some information'।

q: Q89. Choose the correctly spelt word.
explain: नियम: c के बाद ei – Receive।

q: Q90. Choose the correctly spelt word.
explain: Accommodation में दो c और दो m होते हैं।

q: Q91. Choose the correctly spelt word.
explain: Necessary – एक c, दो s।

q: Q92. Choose the correct plural of 'criterion'.
explain: Criterion (एकवचन) → Criteria (बहुवचन); Phenomenon → Phenomena।

q: Q93. Choose the correct option: The furniture in this room ___ new.
explain: Furniture, luggage, information, advice – uncountable, एकवचन क्रिया।

q: Q94. Choose the correct option: Hardly had he reached the station ___ the train left.
explain: Hardly / Scarcely ... when; No sooner ... than।

q: Q95. Choose the correct option: No sooner did he see the police ___ he ran away.
explain: No sooner ... than।

q: Q96. Choose the correct option: Unless you work hard, you ___.
explain: Unless = if not; इसलिए अर्थ के अनुसार 'will not pass' – Unless के साथ not दोबारा नहीं लगता।

q: Q97. Choose the correct option: He is one of the best players that ___ ever played for India.
explain: 'one of the best players that...' में that का antecedent 'players' (बहुवचन) है।

q: Q98. Choose the correct option: It is high time we ___ the work.
explain: 'It is high time' के बाद Past tense (subjunctive)।

q: Q99. Choose the correct option: I wish I ___ a doctor.
explain: I wish (काल्पनिक इच्छा) के बाद 'were'।

q: Q100. Choose the correct option: He walked ___ the road carefully.
explain: सड़क पार करना – across; सड़क के किनारे-किनारे चलना – along।
